name: thimble
description: thimble for Claude Code: the `thimble` command reads and queries any files and keeps the code, inputs and source rows behind every value. Each card Claude saves is drawn under its reply and opens in a detail view that keeps the chat going; each citation opens the rows it cites. After each of Claude's messages an observer reads it with the whole session: it lights v when another view would help, marks the terms the person may not know, and keeps the session's claims. A click on `thimble` in the bar, or /thimble-settings, turns each feature on or off.

cards.title: Cards
cards.description: v makes a chart or a table of an answer, and lights up when one would show more. A small part of the call after each reply; then one card each time you ask.

squeeze.title: Squeeze and catch-up
squeeze.description: s makes an answer shorter or longer, and catches you up on replies you missed. A few words of the call after each reply; then one rewrite each time you ask.

explain.title: Explainers
explain.description: Marks the terms you may not know; ] opens what each one means here. A small part of the call after each reply.

details.title: Important details
details.description: Marks the details of an answer that are easy to miss and change what it means. A small part of the call after each reply.

claims.title: Claims
claims.description: c opens what Claude and you claimed in the session, with sources; the bar counts them. The largest part of the call after each reply.

counts.title: Labels and coverage on the bar
counts.description: The bar shows how much of the data Claude has seen (r coverage) and how many labels there are (l). No model call: thimble counts the files after each turn.

squeezeCards.title: Squeeze changes cards (experimental)
squeezeCards.description: When s makes an answer much shorter or longer, or writes it for another reader, it may edit, add or leave out a card with the text. 0 brings the cards back as they were. Each rewrite also reads the cards and the outputs they draw on.
